title: Create retrieval eval fixtures including stale cases
summary: Create a small eval dataset for current answers, absent facts, scope isolation, and stale/superseded history. This task comes before ranking changes.

title: Implement conservative project file miner
summary: Import markdown/text project files with provenance, deterministic dedupe, project default scope, and no LLM. This closes the biggest usefulness gap versus MemPalace.

title: Improve wake into layered current context
summary: Make wake output prioritize active decisions, constraints, handoffs, and recent notes in L0/L1/L2-style sections while keeping sourced evidence blocks and hard max-char budgets.

title: Add agent hook system
summary: Add Recoil hook reminder formats and installer support for hook-capable agents, starting with Claude Code and documented OpenCode/Codex wiring.
